name: Casco Food Equipment Services Inc
old_description: Get comprehensive maintenance and on-demand commercial food equipment repairs from New Hampshire’s most reliable provider.
about:
Casco Food Equipment Services Inc is headquartered in Manchester, New Hampshire. The company, led by CEO Sam Moy, has provided commercial food equipment repairs and parts across New Hampshire and beyond for years, establishing itself as the state's premier provider for the foodservice industry.

The firm operates as an authorized parts and service distributor for more than 50 manufacturers, maintaining a parts inventory valued at over $1.6 million. Its factory-authorized, CFESA-certified technicians provide 24/7 emergency repairs, preventative maintenance programs, warranty administration, and equipment installation for a wide range of cooking and refrigeration equipment including convection ovens, griddles, charbroilers, combi ovens, steamers, kettles, tilt skillets, fryers, pizza ovens, dishwashers, and toasters.

Casco serves the foodservice and restaurant industries, supporting commercial kitchens throughout New England with same-day repair capability and ongoing maintenance contracts.

The company distinguishes itself with the highest first-call fix rate in New England, round-the-clock technician availability, and its status as a factory-authorized service agent ensuring proper warranty protection for customers.
